description: Hi there, my name is Josiah. I'm 4 years old and fascinated with planets and everything space related. This is Little Explorers Big Universe! My mum, dad and I are travelling to Mars to investigate all of the equipment we've found. Together we'll be building an illustrated picture/fact/activity story for children to learn with. We would love to work with others with an interest in Science/Arts/Technology.🌕 🌑 ☄️ 🌌👨‍👩‍👦🔴🛰️
